write.bin/pi:
#!/bin/sh
D="$HOME/calls"
C="$HOME/canned"
mkdir -p "$D"
case "$1" in
  login|auth) echo "status $*" >> "$D/pi.txt"; echo "signed in with an api key"; exit 0 ;;
esac
n=0
[ -f "$D/pi.n" ] && read n < "$D/pi.n"
n=$((n + 1))
echo "$n" > "$D/pi.n"
pick() { if [ -f "$C/pi.$1.$n" ]; then echo "$C/pi.$1.$n"; else echo "$C/pi.$1"; fi; }
{
  echo "call $n"
  echo "cwd $(pwd -P)"
  for a in "$@"; do echo "arg $a"; done
  echo "env AGENT_KIT_DELEGATION=${AGENT_KIT_DELEGATION-<unset>}"
  echo "env MISTRAL_API_KEY=${MISTRAL_API_KEY-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_HOME=${VIBE_HOME-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_ENABLE_MCP=${VIBE_ENABLE_MCP-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_ENABLE_SUBAGENTS=${VIBE_ENABLE_SUBAGENTS-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_INCLUDE_PROJECT_CONTEXT=${VIBE_INCLUDE_PROJECT_CONTEXT-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_OUTSIDE_WORKDIR=${VIBE_OUTSIDE_WORKDIR-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_MCP_SERVERS=${VIBE_MCP_SERVERS-<unset>}"
} >> "$D/pi.txt"

prev=
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$prev" in
    --output-dir) outdir=$a ;;
    --usage-file) usage=$a ;;
  esac
  prev=$a
done
f=$(pick act)
[ -f "$f" ] && . "$f"
f=$(pick export)
if [ -n "$outdir" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then mkdir -p "$outdir"; cat "$f" > "$outdir/export.json"; fi
f=$(pick usage)
if [ -n "$usage" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then cat "$f" > "$usage"; fi
f=$(pick sleep)
[ -f "$f" ] && exec sleep 30
f=$(pick out)
[ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f"
f=$(pick err)
[ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f" >&2
ex=0
f=$(pick exit)
[ -f "$f" ] && read ex < "$f"
exit "$ex"
write.bin/agent-launcher:
#!/bin/sh
D="$HOME/calls"
mkdir -p "$D"
{
  echo "launcher $*"
  echo "env PATH=$PATH"
  echo "env PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=${PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR-<unset>}"
  echo "env TMPDIR=${TMPDIR-<unset>}"
  echo "agent settings.json: $(cat "$PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/settings.json")"
  echo "agent models.json: $(cat "$PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/models.json")"
} >> "$D/launcher.txt"
while [ "$1" != "--" ]; do shift; done
shift
exec "$@"

write.bin/vibe:
#!/bin/sh
D="$HOME/calls"
mkdir -p "$D"
case "$*" in
  *model-gateway-probe*)
    echo "Error: unknown model 'model-gateway-probe'. Available: mistral-small-latest, mistral-large-latest, glm-5-3, deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017." >&2
    exit 1 ;;
esac
echo "vibe $*" >> "$D/vibe.txt"
prev=
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$prev" in
    --output-dir) outdir=$a ;;
  esac
  prev=$a
done
if [ -n "$outdir" ]; then mkdir -p "$outdir"; cat "$HOME/canned/vibe.export" > "$outdir/export.json"; fi
cat "$HOME/canned/vibe.out"
write.home/canned/vibe.out: [{"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The plan reads well.\nSUMMARY: plan is fine"}]}]
